scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @authenti8/web" "npm run dev -w @authenti8/api"
scripts.build: npm run build:foundation && npm run build -w @authenti8/api && npm run build -w @authenti8/web
scripts.build:foundation: npm run build -w @authenti8/contracts && npm run build -w @authenti8/event-schemas && npm run build -w @authenti8/detection-rules && npm run build -w @authenti8/validation && npm run build -w @authenti8/security && npm run build -w @authenti8/ui && npm run build -w @authenti8/recruiter-extension && npm run build -w @authenti8/candidate-extension && npm run build -w @authenti8/windows-agent && npm run build -w @authenti8/macos-agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:foundation && npm run typecheck -w @authenti8/api && npm run typecheck -w @authenti8/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @authenti8/api && npm run test -w @authenti8/validation && npm run test -w @authenti8/detection-rules && npm run test -w @authenti8/candidate-extension && npm run test -w @authenti8/recruiter-extension && npm run test -w @authenti8/windows-agent && npm run test -w @authenti8/macos-agent
scripts.accuracy: npm run build -w @authenti8/windows-agent && npm run build -w @authenti8/macos-agent && node scripts/accuracy-runner.mjs && node scripts/accuracy-harness.mjs accuracy-runner-results/windows.json accuracy-runner-results/macos.json
scripts.accuracy:windows: npm run build -w @authenti8/windows-agent && node scripts/accuracy-runner.mjs --platform WINDOWS
scripts.accuracy:macos: npm run build -w @authenti8/macos-agent && node scripts/accuracy-runner.mjs --platform MACOS
